cards.title: Cortex, membrane and motor construction geometry
cards.expression: r_shell = R - a_realized^2/(6R) - erm.r0 - h/2; N_cortex = round(4*pi*r_shell^2*density); N_NMII uses the same shell area
cards.qualification: a_realized is the realized mesh edge, not simply the input target spacing. Shared geometry does not establish biological abundance covariance.

cards.title: Material quantities become geometry-dependent coefficients
cards.expression: axial = EA/chord; bend = kappa/mean(adjacent_chords); node_mass = rho*pi*r^2*sum(incident_chords)/2
cards.qualification: These are derived coefficients on realized geometry, not additional biological free parameters.

cards.title: Membrane excess area and its geometric carriers
cards.expression: f_wrinkle = max(f_total - f_tubes, 0); f_tubes = A_tubed_mesh/A_smooth_mesh - 1; f_tubes cannot exceed f_total
cards.qualification: The implemented tube area is measured from constructed geometry. A cylinder-area approximation is not the implemented exact budget.

cards.title: ERM abundance, capture and occupancy are different quantities
cards.expression: capacity = min(round(density*A_built), membrane_nodes); ideal_zero_load_fraction = k_on/(k_on+k_off0); Fchar = kBT/x_beta
cards.qualification: The fraction is the stationary two-state rate-matrix result before geometric capture and load limits. Capacity is not realized occupied links.

cards.title: Assembled motors, competent heads and cycle occupancy
cards.expression: assembled_heads = 2*heads_per_side*N_assembled; with object_life: p_assembled = ka/(ka+kd), N_total = round(N_assembled/p_assembled); built_heads = 2*heads_per_side*N_total; three-state zero-load pi proportional to (1,a/(b+c),a*c/(d*(b+c)))
cards.qualification: The stationary expression uses a=k_on, b=k_off0, c=k_stroke, d=k_adp_release. It does not apply to five/seven/eight-state cycles, geometric capture constraints or load-dependent duty. In this implementation competent_head_fraction directly validates and returns nmii.rlc_phosphorylated_fraction. Whole-object assembly and cycle occupancy remain separate. When object_life is off, N_total=N_assembled. If ka=kd=0 the implementation uses no reserve; ka=0 with kd>0 refuses.

cards.title: Motor chemistry shares temperature and nucleotide context
cards.expression: kBT = 1.380649e-5*T; Fchar = kBT/x; MgATP_fraction = Mg_free/(Kd+Mg_free); association_rate = association_coefficient*MgATP_fraction*ATP_concentration
cards.qualification: Free Mg and total ATP are distinct. Source-derived actin bending stiffness is a stored literal; changing temperature does not recompute that parameter.

cards.title: Transport speed, priming and lifetime consistency
cards.expression: walk rates = v/(spacing*f), v/(spacing*(1-f)); expected run length = v/k_off0; existing guard compares expected/stated run length
cards.qualification: One node-spacing event represents multiple molecular cycles. Molecular step-size statistics cannot be inferred from these events. The atlas does not change the guard tolerance.

cards.title: IF architecture and nuclear size share a construction rule
cards.expression: Rn = R*nc_ratio; shell = Rn+gap; historical_span = r_cortex-Rn-2*gap; r_mid = Rn+gap+historical_span/2; contour_target = 4*pi*r_mid^2*historical_span/mesh^2; rings = round(contour_target/(2*pi*shell)); EA = E*pi*r^2; kappa = E*pi*r^4/4
cards.qualification: Contour preservation from a former spoke construction is an explicit model choice. It is not a measured IF density law. Surface remapping changes realized contour.

cards.title: Nuclear links reuse parameters with distinct meanings
cards.expression: lamina vertices = round(4*pi*Rn^2/lamina.filament^2); lamina-envelope links limited by round(linc_density*A_envelope) and available nodes; chromatin crosslinks = round(0.5*crosslink_fraction*domain_count)
cards.qualification: Shared linc.k does not establish empirical equality of mechanics. linc.tension is an observer comparison row, not a stiffness input.

cards.title: Pore conductance and areal conductivity
cards.expression: G_single = pi*r^4/(8*eta*L); Lp_areal = pore_density*G_single; pore_density*pi*r^2 < 1; pore_length >= envelope.spacing
cards.qualification: Single-pore G is mislabeled with areal Lp units in the current docstring; this card reports dimensional algebra, not a runtime fix. The cylinder formula omits entrance and mesh resistance.

cards.title: Osmolarity, accessible water volume and molecule inventory
cards.expression: Vwater_cyt = f_cyt*(Vmem-Vnuc); Vwater_nuc = f_nuc*Vnuc; molecules = c_mM*Vwater*602214.076; pressure_per_mM is checked against R*T_reference
cards.qualification: Conditional on water_permeation. Fixed impermeant solute counts do not model arbitrary small-solute equilibration. Surface pressure/volume penalties and double-sheet cases have explicit refusals.

cards.title: Reference Reynolds number is a build diagnostic
cards.qualification: Reference motor speed and Reynolds number are derived diagnostics, not measured run speed or hydrodynamic validation.

reviewed_inputs.scope: Manually inspected code and selected declarations; changing these fingerprints requires actual re-review.
